final_collapse.text: The final collapse comes at a FIXED moment: 24 in-game hours into Day 10 (hour 240 of the floor). A Long Rest never ends the floor and never skips it; the System cuts short any rest that would run past the collapse.

collapse_miss.text: Any Crawler not at a stairwell when the floor collapses is dead, and all Crawlers still on the floor die with it. There is no Reprieve, no toll and no detour for it. canon.name: Kobold training grounds and the dog pound (Ralph)
canon.announcement_style: The boss intro is a darkly funny history lesson about gerbils and the Black Death, then a flat "you might want to duck."
canon.staging: Heavy distorted-barking music pours from a converted municipal dog pound: three hallways of cages, injured dingoes inside. Feeding a caged dingo a pet biscuit turns it from hostile to friendly, so the boss fight can be won by cashing in the animals the kobolds abuse. About forty kobolds march in with Ralph in a small cage; when the dingoes are loosed, one swallows him, but he is not dead. The prize room is a pet reward room with a line of caged monsters.

canon.name: Kobold training grounds and the dog pound (Ralph)
canon.announcement_style: The boss intro is a darkly funny history lesson about gerbils and the Black Death, then a flat "you might want to duck."
canon.staging: Heavy distorted-barking music pours from a converted municipal dog pound: three hallways of cages, injured dingoes inside. Feeding a caged dingo a pet biscuit turns it from hostile to friendly, so the boss fight can be won by cashing in the animals the kobolds abuse. About forty kobolds march in with Ralph in a small cage; when the dingoes are loosed, one swallows him, but he is not dead. The prize room is a pet reward room with a line of caged monsters.
